command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
printf '29d7d7fcb0de656a399deb833eb099e771762540421cdb6e279e7ddd4bba8b5c  real.py\n834b46183e152a3c9b5ae50b55dc0d6960c30e236be08c2391e62723e708b920  colhash.py\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u colhash.py 2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/colhash.txt
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 || { echo 'FAIL: colhash'; exit 1; }
